title: SR, session record
description: One agent session: where it ran (harness, provider, account and plan), model and version, effort, folder and branch, duration, tokens, the PRs, items, actions and DDRs it touched, and a short summary. Computed from the session's transcript at zero token; a snapshot in ~/.brain/sessions/<session>.json, and once reviewed records/sr/<yyyy-mm>/<id>.yaml. The transcript itself is not copied.

id.description: sr-<start date>-<first 8 characters of the session id>.

tool.description: The harness that ran the session, as engines before harness wrote it: still written, harness's fallback (wi-brain-session-provenance).

provider.description: The model's provider: anthropic, bedrock, vertex, foundry... (brain.provenance: the session's environment, else the account's, else the model's id).

harness.description: The tool that ran the session: claude-code, cursor... It takes over tool, which readers use when it is absent.

account.description: The alias of the account the session ran on (config.json usage.accounts, or BRAIN_ACCOUNT): never an e-mail address, never an account id.

plan.description: The account's plan, a label (config.json usage.accounts, else usage.plans).

title.description: The session's title (custom-title in the transcript).

summary.description: A short summary: the title by default, or what brain record sr --summary gives.

model.description: The model of most API messages.

effort.description: The effort level of most API messages.

active_s.description: Wall clock without the gaps longer than 5 minutes.

budget.description: The budget the brief announced ('Context budget: 600k').

peak.description: Largest context of one API call (input + cache read + cache write).

task_class.description: The task class the brief announced ('Task class: strategic'); brainstorm marks a brainstorm, which brain.governor caps.

host_id.description: The desktop app's id of the session (CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_SESSION_ID), the one SendMessage and the app's session tools take; session_id is the transcript's (wi-brain-session-tree).

name.description: The short name the app gave a session another one started (its metadata's spawnedFrom.name).

parent.description: The app's id of the session that started this one (spawnedFrom.sessionId), else its transcript id from the brief hash.

children.description: The ids of the sessions this one started, the app's when known.

role.description: Computed when the snapshot is written: master (it started sessions), sub (a session started it), relay (both), solo.

ultracode.description: Whether ultracode was on at any time in the session (the app's ultra_effort_enter attachment), so the ledgers tell its spend apart.

cost_usd.description: The cost Claude Code reports (cost-state), notional on a subscription.

end_reason.description: SessionEnd reason (clear, resume, logout, prompt_input_exit, other).

path.description: Relative to the tool's transcript folder (~/.claude/projects).

archived.description: Where the archived copy lives, once the archive exists (wi-brain-session-archive).

tokens.description: Summed once per API message (a message's usage repeats on each of its content blocks).
